note: Production Rive scene uses the mother image and deterministic source-pixel rig layers. ROUND7: full decompose — face/hair/choker/belt/hem/legs crops + selective Mesh on legs/fingers/coat-tails. Finger phalanx sub-crops skipped. ROUND8: vest/shorts/belt-band, continuous leg skin, all cut from the mother pixels.  ROUND9: one continuous hand crop per side (wrist+palm+thumb+fingers cut once from the mother, skinned to a finger skeleton); hand/ribbon/thigh pixels removed from cuff, sleeve and hem crops. ROUND10: cuff band drawn once (sleeve crops lose the baked-in band), orange ribbon shards removed from cuff/sleeve crops. ROUND10 hand pieces: palm + 5 finger pieces cut from the single ROUND9 hand crop by capsule ownership (hinge/edge overlap <= 2.5px), each skinned only to its own bones. ROUND13 hem: coat-tail crops removed (fully hidden duplicates); hem ribbons unchanged pixels, now skinned. ROUND13 hair: side-lock pixels moved (not copied) out of the head-group crops into hair-lock-{l,r}. ROUND13 collar: hair-l strand tip on the shoulder moved (not copied) into hair-tip-l. ROUND14 eyes: eye pixels moved (not copied) into per-part eye layers; eyelid skin inpainted from neighbouring skin. ROUND14 brows: brow-line px moved into brow-l/r; the hair under them in head.png is inpainted from the neighbouring bangs. ROUND14 bangs: bang px moved into bangs-{a,b,c}; the forehead under them in head.png is inpainted from neighbouring skin (hair px kept where never uncovered). ROUND20 backhair: neck-side peeks moved from head into hair-back-{l,r} skinned chains. ROUND20 lid: closed-eye skin re-shade + feather; head eye-hole rim soften. ROUND22: coat-l/r-shoulder dark lining pixels moved into coat-l/r-shoulder-lining (+2 px border copy under the lapel against filtering seams). ROUND23: removed never-drawn assets sleeve-l-upper.png, sleeve-l-lower.png, sleeve-r-upper.png, sleeve-r-lower.png, coat-l-shoulder-orange.png, sleeve-l-upper-dark.png, sleeve-l-upper-orange.png, sleeve-l-lower-dark.png, sleeve-l-lower-orange.png, coat-r-shoulder-orange.png, sleeve-r-upper-dark.png, sleeve-r-upper-orange.png, sleeve-r-lower-dark.png, sleeve-r-lower-orange.png, sleeve-l-bent.png, sleeve-r-bent.png. ROUND24: body-backfill gains the two enclosed right-waist cut-outs of the mother (under belt band / coat edge), inpainted from neighbouring source pixels. ROUND25: shoulder-cap pixels moved (not copied) from head.png into arm-l/r-shoulder-skin.png (same screen position; deterministic, no AI). ROUND27: coat front panels (placket, lining strip, leather trim, hem-tail lines) moved (not copied) from sleeve-{l,r}-full(.dark).png into coat-{l,r}-front.png; sleeve under the panel's opaque core backfilled by deterministic cv2 Telea inpaint from neighbouring sleeve pixels (10 px seam band + shaded underside). ROUND30: strengthen sleeve-{l,r}-full.png backfill under the full coat panel body (no 2px erosion / alpha feather) so R27d gravity hang no longer reveals background holes. ROUND31: body-backfill converted to bare-skin torso/hip underlay; shoulder-skin orange rim cleaned; arm-l/r-under-skin added under sleeves for coat-hide continuity. ROUND31c: shorts side orange accents split into shorts-side-orange.png. ROUND32: anatomical bare-body backfill + tapered arm-under-skin; neutral underlayer top/bottom layers; finger rest loop-safe (R32a). ROUND33a: socks split from leg skins into sock-l/r. ROUND33b: thigh strap split from leg-l-skin. ROUND33c: hair-bow extracted from hair-lock-r. ROUND34a: belt split from fabric; waist-backfill under belt. ROUND34b: pouch split + skinned with lag. ROUND34c: badge split + skinned lanyard. ROUND35a: real choker split from mouth/head; tank neckline into torso-tank. ROUND35b: hair-lock-l/back orange ornaments migrated to ornament-l/bow; coat blobs to coat. ROUND35c: neutral coat scraps cleaned; belt lanyard ring → badge. ROUND35c belt left scrap. ROUND39 bone fist: every finger crop split into meta/p0/p1/p2 phalanx pieces (original pixels, knuckle caps from original opaque pixels), rigid to joint-centred bones; R38 procedural fist removed.
